title: Spells & Vessels Shop
description: A whimsical fantasy storefront entrance with a large swirling purple and green vortex door. The shop sign reads 'Spells & Vessels - Est. 0223' and features a small green boat hanging above it. The wooden building facade is decorated with hanging miniature boats, paper scrolls, and glowing lanterns against a painted teal and yellow sky backdrop.
prompt: A colorful whimsical fantasy shop entrance named Spells & Vessels Est. 0223, featuring a large circular swirling vortex door in vibrant purple, green and yellow patterns. The wooden building facade has hanging miniature boats, paper scrolls with text, glowing lanterns, and a sign with a small green boat hanging above it.
